---
title: 1Password Item Demo
---

# 1Password Item

This runbook saves a credential to 1Password with the `<OnePasswordItem>` block. A script stands in for whatever creates the credential in a real runbook, such as a command that creates an AWS IAM user and its access key.

You need the [1Password CLI](https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/get-started/) installed, with **Settings > Developer > Integrate with 1Password CLI** turned on in the 1Password app.

<Prerequisites id="tools">
```yaml
tools:
  - name: op
    description: The 1Password CLI, which saves the item.
    install: "[Install the 1Password CLI](https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/get-started/)"
```
</Prerequisites>

## Step 1: Choose where to save it

<Inputs id="item">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: Vault
    type: string
    description: The 1Password vault to save the item in
    default: Private
  - name: Title
    type: string
    description: The item's title
    default: Runbooks demo credential
```
</Inputs>

## Step 2: Create a credential

This script makes up an access key. It writes the secret half with `sensitive:`, so Runbooks masks it everywhere it shows it.

<Command
  id="make-credential"
  title="Create a demo credential"
  command='echo "ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc A-Z0-9 </dev/urandom | head -c 16)" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"; echo "sensitive:SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 </dev/urandom | head -c 40)" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"'
/>

## Step 3: Save it to 1Password

1Password asks you to approve the change.

<OnePasswordItem
  id="save-credential"
  inputsId="item"
  vault="{{ .inputs.Vault }}"
  itemTitle="{{ .inputs.Title }}"
  category="API Credential"
  username="{{ .outputs.make_credential.ACCESS_KEY_ID }}"
  password="{{ .outputs.make_credential.SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}"
  url="https://console.aws.amazon.com/"
  notes="Saved by the 1Password Item demo runbook. Safe to delete."
  fields={[{ label: "created by", value: "Runbooks demo", type: "text" }]}
  tags={["runbooks-demo"]}
/>

## Step 4: Use the item

Later blocks know where the item is, but not what it holds.

<Command
  id="show-item"
  title="Show where the item is"
  env={{
    OP_VAULT: "{{ .outputs.save_credential.OP_VAULT }}",
    OP_ITEM_ID: "{{ .outputs.save_credential.OP_ITEM_ID }}",
  }}
  command='echo "Saved as op://$OP_VAULT/$OP_ITEM_ID"'
/>
